message: Field "Clock.day": @updatedAt is not supported on this column, because Prisma 8 has no generator for column type "date" yet. Remove @updatedAt: Prisma 7's next migration is empty, but neither client then fills the value, so both require it on create and leave it unchanged on update.

Field "Clock.time": @updatedAt is not supported on this column, because Prisma 8 has no generator for column type "time" yet. Remove @updatedAt: Prisma 7's next migration is empty, but neither client then fills the value, so both require it on create and leave it unchanged on update.

Field "Clock.optional": @updatedAt is not supported on this column, because Prisma 8 has no generator for column type "date" yet. Remove @updatedAt: Prisma 7's next migration is empty, but neither client then fills the value, so it stays empty unless a client writes it, and updates leave it unchanged.

Field "Clock.defaulted": @updatedAt is not supported on this column, because Prisma 8 has no generator for column type "date" yet. Remove @updatedAt: Prisma 7's next migration is empty. Its @default(now()) still sets the value on create, and neither client changes it on update.
